# Passion Corners

> > Passion Corners showcases Rock Cliff PMC construction project management consultancy and Lennox Trading forex education services.

A portfolio hub featuring two distinct ventures: Rock Cliff PMC, a construction project management consultancy based in Cairns, Queensland, Australia specializing in claims and dispute resolution; and Lennox Trading, a forex trading education service founded by Lachlan offering mentorship through IM Academy and TradingView.

## Construction Project Management

- [Rock Cliff – Project Management Consultancy](https://rock-cliff.passioncorners.com): Rock Cliff PMC homepage: construction project management consultancy services including claims and dispute resolution, contractor support, and litigation support in Cairns, Queensland, Australia

## Trading Education & Financial Services

- [Lennox Trading](https://lennox.passioncorners.com): Lennox Trading homepage: Forex and cryptocurrency trading education by founder Lachlan, offering trading mentorship, consultation services via IM Academy and TradingView for financial freedom
